requestBody.description: A PayPal webhook event, exactly as PayPal sent it

csrf_token.description: Send this in the X-CSRFToken header of every POST, PATCH and DELETE

paypal_client_id.description: Public PayPal client ID for the JS SDK; empty in mock mode

rate.description: KES for 1 USD, as a decimal string

source.description: open_er_api, or static for the fallback

is_live.description: False when the rate is the static one

is_stale.description: A live rate that has not been refreshed for six hours

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units: positive into the account, negative out

hash_short.description: First 12 characters of the entry hash

donor_name.description: Only on the donation line, and only if the donor gave a name

valid.description: True only if the whole chain is intact and has this case's entries

last_hash.description: Hash of this case's newest entry (zeros if it has none)

error.description: Last line of the error, personal data removed

queues.description: Null if the queue server cannot be reached

reason.description: Why the case is being paused (10 to 300 characters)
created, or why no tranche was due: case_not_settleable, no_confirmation, hospital_inactive, hospital_not_ready, cap_reached, nothing_available, below_threshold

preview_url.description: A five-minute link to your own upload while the original exists

file.description: A PDF, PNG or JPEG of at most 10 MB

ready.description: False until the automatic checks have run

amount_usd.description: US dollars, $1 to $10,000, at most two decimals

excess_choice.description: What happens to money the case does not need

donor_display_name.description: Shown beside the donation in the public ledger

order_id.description: Give this to the PayPal button

kes_estimate_minor.description: KES value of the net amount at the rate when it was paid

ledger_hash_short.description: First 12 characters of the ledger entry hash

destination_masked.description: The register's official address, masked. Codes go nowhere else.

note.description: Shown to the family. Do not include medical details.

status.description: received for a new event, duplicate for one seen before
